runs.time_budget_change: At user's request to wrap up in about 10 minutes, stopped new directions and sent incoherent first-strength replies directly to 0.5×. Saved attempts retained.

runs.pair_budget_note: Initial exact-text subset uses 1×, 0.75×, 0.5×. Missing pairs added after semantic retest review start directly at 0.75×, then retry at 0.5×, to fit the wrap-up budget.

runs.selection: Equal random fresh units per layer, excluding all previously screened library units; both signs, shuffled once before generation. Time cutoff may leave incomplete units.
runs.normalization: Signed unit effective MLP write column, including learned MLP gain, multiplied by prompt residual median norm and dose; added after the block at all positions.
runs.judging: Codex editorial review of deduplicated discovery replies and selected pair replies; mechanical triage is not a quality or identity judge. Unreviewed outputs retain no invented ratings.
runs.goal: Surprising, readable new personas; literal preservation of both parent identities is not required.
limitations: Time-limited exploratory sample, not an exhaustive atlas
Wide screen uses one fixed 1.0× dose and 48-token cap; finalists use 160 tokens
Selection is editorial, not blinded or a population estimate

resumes.reason: Measured throughput optimization; preserve all prior attempts and skip previously generated conditions.

runs.coverage_note: Only generated conditions are counted. Additional enrichment plans and all amendments are preserved separately; planned but unexecuted neurons are excluded.
rounds: Full solo reruns and editorial selection
runs.sampling: Time-limited fresh stratified random sample, plus two fixed stronger-dose random enrichments in layers 20–39; all old library units excluded. See enrichment_plan.json, supplemental_plan.json and protocol_amendments.json. Not a population-rate estimate.

pair_playground.selection: Eight purposefully chosen pairs from already saved solos, selected for historical themes or playful contrasts; not a random sample.
pair_playground.intervention: Same normalized effective MLP write directions as the atlas. Each parent scaled independently relative to its selected solo dose.

browsing_ratings.judge: GPT-6 Luna via three Codex subagents
browsing_ratings.scope: All 1,440 selected single-neuron replies; 1,019 whitespace/case-normalized unique texts rated once, without old labels or neuron metadata.

novelty_sprint.selection: Surprising readable new personas; literal blending is not required.
novelty_sprint.method: 32/48/96-token discovery previews, core 160-token reruns, and late 64/96-token pair trials. New personas selected for surprise, specificity and readability, with no literal-blending requirement. The 42 selected discoveries also have separate Codex weirdness/coherence ratings; other trials remain unscored.
